internal_grouping_rule: Each internal EDC graph ID 0–80 and its 10 paired internal DUD-E decoys from graph IDs 87–896 were assigned to one parent group.
external_validation_rule: The external graphs (81–86 and 897–902) were excluded from all internal split, hyperparameter-selection, and training steps. After internal model selection, the selected configuration was refit using all 891 internal compounds and evaluated once on the 12 external compounds.
